Name: NPC Birthday Notifications And Gift Suggestions
Author: stebaker92
Description:
[b][size=5]NPC Birthday Notifications & Gift Suggestions[/size]
[/b]
Never forget a villager's birthday again! Each morning, you'll receive a notification reminding you of today & tomorrow's birthday celebrations, along with gift suggestions based on known gift preferences

[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Daily Birthday Notifications[/b]: Wake up to alerts for today's and tomorrow's birthdays[/*]
[*][b]Smart Gift Suggestions[/b]: Receive personalized gift recommendations based on each NPC's known preferences[/*]
[*][b]Fully Configurable[/b]: Customize notifications via simple config.json settings[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.1.10 Compatible[/b]: Built for Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][b]Lightweight & Performance-Friendly[/b]: No impact on game performance[/*]
[/list]

[b][size=4]Configuration Options[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Toggle tomorrow's birthday alerts (NotifyOnDayBefore)[/*]
[*]Enable/disable gift suggestions (SuggestGift)[/*]
[*]Easy config.json editing - no coding required[/*]
[/list]
You can find config in the following path within your Stardew Valley install location: e.g.
[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Stardew.BirthdayNotifications\config.json[/i]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Built for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.1.10. This may work with newer versions but if not, leave a comment and I will update the mod

[heading]Support & Feedback[/heading]

[/list]
